#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CLI with TOML config support using cyclopts."""

import cyclopts
from pathlib import Path

config_file = Path("pyproject.toml")
if not config_file.exists():
    config_file.write_text("""[tool.mycli]
name = "Alice"
greeting = "Hi"
count = 3
""")

app = cyclopts.App(
    config_file="pyproject.toml",
    config_section="tool.mycli",
)

@app.default
def greet(
    name: str = "World",
    greeting: str = "Hello",
    count: int = 1,
):
    """Greet someone.
    
    Args:
        name: Person to greet.
        greeting: Greeting word to use.
        count: Number of times to greet.
    """
    for _ in range(count):
        print(f"{greeting}, {name}!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
